requirements.title: IEEE_GET_MODES argument and saved modes value
requirements.source: S17.11.7 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF490.
requirements.definition: MODES shall be a scalar IEEE_MODES_TYPE INTENT(OUT) argument assigned the current floating-point modes.

pending.IEEE_GET_MODES-MODES-scalar-ieee-modes-t: Positive source control declares TYPE(IEEE_MODES_TYPE) :: modes and calls IEEE_GET_MODES(modes); source-control mutation uses TYPE(IEEE_STATUS_TYPE) and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_GET_MODES-assigns-current-modes: Rounding component: read the current binary rounding mode, save modes with IEEE_GET_MODES, then choose IEEE_UP for non-IEEE_UP current values and IEEE_DOWN for an IEEE_UP current value after probing IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING for the chosen mode with X=0.0. Set that different mode, verify IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE reports the changed value, call IEEE_SET_MODES(saved), and assert IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE returns the original value. Underflow component: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(0.0), read current GRADUAL, save modes, set .not. GRADUAL with IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE, verify IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE changed, restore with IEEE_SET_MODES(saved), and assert the original GRADUAL value is back. Halting component: for each listed flag F, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(F), read h0 with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(F,h0), save modes with IEEE_GET_MODES(saved), set IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(F,.not.h0), perform no floating-point operation or other operation that could signal F while halting is .TRUE., read h1 with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(F,h1), assert h1 == .not.h0, restore with IEEE_SET_MODES(saved), assert IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(F) returns h0, and finally ensure IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(F,.FALSE.) before any later exception-signaling row.
